entries.zh: 点数；点报时辰（点更计时）
entries.en: to count points (on the tally); to count the hours (mark time by points)

entries.notes: 官话对音标 T99 污损，R 栏另有 zn̄/sū 存疑，四栏不齐整故降级。

entries.en: to do arithmetic; to count numbers
entries.notes: R 栏第二字对音 T99 污损并存疑（zn̄/sū），依赖推断展开。

entries.zh: 像（谷）箕那样数数（计数之具/之式）；〔第二汉字形存疑：箕/棋/基〕
entries.en: to count as with winnowing baskets (counting by measures)
entries.notes: 西语 logaros/lograros 存疑，汉字第二字形三案并存，释义依四栏大意推断。

entries.en: to count with the abacus; to reckon with counters

entries.zh: 数用算：用算（盘）来计数记账
entries.en: to count and make reckonings, using the abacus
entries.notes: R 栏首字对音 T99 污损存疑（zn̄/sū）。

entries.zh: 通共总算：把一切合起来总计
entries.en: to count everything together; to reckon all in one sum
entries.notes: 汉字搃/总、同/通均存疑，M、R 栏对音亦有疑，整体依语义推断。

entries.zh: 唱班：报更唱名（原西语释义末段残缺）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to call the watch in rounds (singing out the hours); Spanish gloss partly illegible
entries.notes: L 标 [残] 末段拼合难辨，仅据汉字与音写推断为报更唱班义。

entries.zh: 总讲：讲讲故事消遣（闲话取乐）；〔汉字形存疑：捨/搃、傾/頃〕
entries.en: to tell tales, to entertain with stories
entries.notes: 汉字字形存疑，依西语 contar fabulas, entretener 与对音定性为闲谈消遣义。

entries.zh: 口算：凭口默算（不假筹策）
entries.en: to count from memory; to reckon by mouth

entries.zh: 抽筹：数筹计数（抽签核数）；〔音写存疑 t'/p'〕
entries.en: to count with tallies (canes); to draw and count counting-sticks
entries.notes: M 栏声母存疑（t'/p'），西语 cañas 指计数竹筹，释义依汉字与西语推断。

entries.zh: 算更：计算更次（打更报时）
entries.en: to count the night watches; to reckon the hours

entries.zh: 算凑：凑齐核算；结算账目
entries.en: to settle the account; to reckon up and balance

entries.zh: 片：计数薄片之物的量词；〔缩写展开存疑（p/y）〕
entries.en: classifier: piece (slip, plate) — numeral for counting thin things
entries.notes: 西语释义缩写残损（Uso t 后难辨），R 对音 giĕn/piĕn 存疑，量词义依赖推断。

entries.en: one who reckons accounts; an accountant, tally-man
entries.notes: R 栏人字对音存疑（zīn/xīn），余三栏互证清晰。

entries.zh: 库官：会计官（掌管账房之官员）
entries.en: treasury officer; accountant of the counting-house

entries.zh: 库吏：账房吏员（管理库房账目者）
entries.en: clerk of the treasury/storehouse; counting-house clerk

entries.zh: 单：单另计；作计数用之单个〔官话对音污损〕
entries.en: to count singly (numeral for counting previous reckonings); single
entries.notes: R 栏 T99 污损难辨，M 栏 tōa/fōa 存疑，依西语 numeral 释义推断为单独计数义。

entries.zh: 点检：清点核对（数目均等相符）；〔汉字眷/審存疑〕
entries.en: to check off and count: reckon the sum as equal
entries.notes: 汉字第二字眷/審存疑，gums/sumas 存疑，依点字与西语清点均等义推断。
